card.label: H.R. 9342
card.summary: The GPO Modernization Act of 2026 updates the programs, operations, and oversight of the Government Publishing Office (GPO). It modernizes the Federal Depository Library Program to include digital formats, establishes a National Collection of U.S. Government Public Information, updates internal GPO administrative and procurement authorities, renames the Joint Committee on Printing to the Joint Committee on Publishing, and replaces hardbound publication requirements for the Library of Congress's Constitution Annotated with digital versions.
card.title: GPO Modernization Act of 2026

title: To direct the Librarian of Congress to promote the more cost-effective, efficient, and expanded availability of the Annotated Constitution and pocket-part supplements by replacing the hardbound versions with digital versions.
